gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed World Health Organization (WHO) Grade IV glioma, confirmed on pathology

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a pilot study to evaluate the feasibility and safety of early postsurgical temozolomide therapy prior to initiation of standard chemoradiation regimen in patients with glioblastoma who undergo inpatient rehabilitation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed World Health Organization (WHO) Grade IV glioma, confirmed on pathology

role_evidence.quote: Patients will begin a 21-day cycle of temozolomide starting 14 days after surgery at 75mg per square meter of body surface area daily to serve as bridge therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, established GBM therapy (early post-surgical bridge schedule)

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset). WHO Grade IV glioma without IDH requirement = historical glioblastoma (D27C); brief summary and description also say glioblastoma. Only agent is temozolomide in a new early post-surgical setting, so established_therapy_only. Subsequent standard chemoradiation is not part of the registered experimental intervention.
